verdict.rationale: The SDK documents programmatic, non-interactive execution through Runner.run(), Runner.run_sync() and Runner.run_streamed(). Environment variables such as OPENAI_DEFAULT_MODEL and OPENAI_AGENTS_DISABLE_TRACING can be set before running agents, so a script can run an agent headlessly from a terminal. A community post confirms that official SDK examples exist, but the pack never shows how to run them from the command line or how an agent would check results that way. missing for 10: documented terminal command or CLI for running the bundled examples, guidance on capturing exit status or output for automated verification, independent hands-on confirmation of headless example runs.
